description: The 26" FATWHEELS Adaptive Training Wheel Bike is perfect for teens or adults still learning to ride and those with special needs. The lightweight aluminum step thru frame offers an easy-on, easy-off experience, and the front suspension fork helps make the ride smooth over a variety of terrain. Multi-use tires and lightweight alloy wheels provide reliable traction and enhanced maneuverability. A versatile 7 speed drivetrain allows the rider to tackle hilly terrain while shifting gears smoothly. The deluxe saddle is comfortable enough for long rides while being easily adjustable for height, and the BMX-style handlebar is adjustable for an angle to add even more customization for the rider. The front & rear PROMAX alloy linear side pull brakes provide plenty of stopping power. The heavy-duty training wheels by FATWHEELS feature real air tires and mag wheels, plus they are removable for riders looking to transition to the next step. Discover the freedom of a bike ride with the 26" FATWHEELS Adaptive Training Wheel Bike – a blend of safety, comfort, and style for an unforgettable riding experience.
